sentences.en: Hello, everybody, and welcome back to The Psychology of Your 20s, the podcast where we talk through some of the big life changes
sentences.zh: 大家好，欢迎回到《二十岁的心理学》，在这个播客里，我们探讨二十岁时经历的一些重大人生变化

sentences.en: and transitions of our 20s and what they mean for our psychology.
sentences.zh: 以及这些转变对我们心理意味着什么。

sentences.en: Hello, everybody.
sentences.zh: 大家好。

sentences.en: Welcome back to the show.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回到节目。

sentences.en: Welcome back to the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回到播客。

sentences.en: New listeners, old listeners, wherever you are in the world, it is so great to have you here back for another episode as we, of course, break down the psychology of our 20s.
sentences.zh: 无论你是新听众还是老朋友，无论你身处世界何地，很高兴你能回来收听新的一期节目，当然，我们依然会深入剖析二十岁的心理。

sentences.en: I've been having this huge desire recently to see what it is like to go without my phone for a week, for a month, maybe forever.
sentences.zh: 最近我产生了一个强烈的愿望，想看看如果一周、一个月，甚至永远不带手机会是什么样子。

sentences.en: And I'm not talking about a digital detox, although that would probably be nice at this point.
sentences.zh: 我指的不是那种数字排毒，虽然现在看来那可能也不错。

sentences.en: I am talking about a full breakup, a full intervention, a full divorce between me and my iPhone because I've been tracking so much of my unhappiness
sentences.zh: 我说的是彻底的分手，彻底的干预，彻底结束我和iPhone之间的关系，因为我发现我的许多不快乐

sentences.en: back to this device that has become ubiquitous in all our lives and what it's been doing to my mind and to my productivity and to my relationships and to my self-esteem.
sentences.zh: 都可以追溯到这个已经渗透到我们生活方方面面的设备，以及它对我的思想、工作效率、人际关系和自尊心所产生的影响。

sentences.en: We are, you know, probably never more than five meters away from our phone at any given time.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们随时随地离手机的距离大概都不会超过五米。

sentences.en: We take it to the bathroom, even if people think that's gross.
sentences.zh: 即使别人觉得恶心，我们还是会把它带进洗手间。

sentences.en: A lot of us do.
sentences.zh: 我们很多人都这样做。

sentences.en: We spend more time with it than our friends and our own parents.
sentences.zh: 我们花在它上面的时间比花在朋友和父母身上的时间还要多。

sentences.en: It is this constant force in our lives.
sentences.zh: 它是我们生活中一股持续存在的力量。

sentences.en: So why aren't we examining our relationship with it more?
sentences.zh: 那么，为什么我们不更多地审视一下我们与它的关系呢？

sentences.en: What's really caused me to start thinking about this was not one, it was actually two things.
sentences.zh: 真正让我开始思考这个问题的不是一件事，而是两件事。

sentences.en: Two things I came across recently.
sentences.zh: 我最近遇到的两件事。

sentences.en: One was a quote, one was an article.
sentences.zh: 一个是名言，一个是文章。

sentences.en: The quote was from Henry David Theroux and it essentially said the cost of anything is the amount of life you exchange for it.
sentences.zh: 那句名言来自亨利·大卫·梭罗，大意是：任何事物的成本，就是你为它所付出的生命代价。

sentences.en: And ironically, it came across my Instagram feed and just kind of reached through the screen and grabbed me.
sentences.zh: 讽刺的是，它出现在我的Instagram信息流里，仿佛穿过屏幕抓住了我。

sentences.en: And my brain immediately was like, oh, this is talking about your phone and the habits that you currently have with this device and how much life or time I'm giving to scrolling
sentences.zh: 我的大脑立刻反应过来：哦，这说的不就是你的手机，你目前使用这个设备的习惯，以及我花了多少生命或时间在刷手机上吗？

sentences.en: and to apps and to social media for very, very little reward.
sentences.zh: 花在应用程序和社交媒体上，却只换来微乎其微的回报。

sentences.en: It is like a pit that I am sinking so much of my day into.
sentences.zh: 这就像一个深坑，我每天的大部分时间都陷在里面。

sentences.en: Almost six hours a day at this point, which is like honestly a bit disgusting when I say it out loud.
sentences.zh: 现在每天几乎要花六个小时，说实话，大声说出来都觉得有点恶心。

sentences.en: And in actuality, for how much time I am spending on this thing,
sentences.zh: 实际上，我花在这东西上的时间，

sentences.en: I'm getting basically nothing from it.
sentences.zh: 我几乎什么都没得到。

sentences.en: And that time would so much be better spent
sentences.zh: 而那些时间如果用来

sentences.en: learning a new skill or experiencing the world or being present with my friends.
sentences.zh: 学习一项新技能、体验世界或陪伴朋友，会好得多。

sentences.en: So that quote really just kind of gripped me and has been running through my head a lot recently.
sentences.zh: 所以那句话真的触动了我，最近一直在我的脑海里回响。

sentences.en: The second thing that has me thinking me and my phone need to get some serious distance was an article written by the ABC that I read about a group of teenagers
sentences.zh: 第二件让我觉得我和手机需要保持严重距离的事，是我读到的一篇ABC写的文章，关于一群青少年，

sentences.en: who call themselves the Luddite Club.
sentences.zh: 他们自称为“卢德分子俱乐部”。

sentences.en: Luddites, I only just learned this, is the name of a group of textile workers who during the Industrial Revolution refused to use machinery.
sentences.zh: 卢德分子，我刚学到这个词，是指工业革命时期拒绝使用机器的一群纺织工人。

sentences.en: They like actively destroyed machinery like they were anti-technology.
sentences.zh: 他们积极地破坏机器，就像是反技术主义者。

sentences.en: These kids, the Luddites,
sentences.zh: 这些孩子，这些“卢德分子”，

sentences.en: they don't have smartphones.
sentences.zh: 他们没有智能手机。

sentences.en: Some of them never had a smartphone.
sentences.zh: 有些人甚至从来没用过智能手机。

sentences.en: They don't use social media.
sentences.zh: 他们不用社交媒体。

sentences.en: They have what they call dumb phones.
sentences.zh: 他们用的是所谓的“笨手机”。

sentences.en: So basically a flip phone with no apps.
sentences.zh: 基本上就是那种没有应用程序的翻盖手机。

sentences.en: It's just for emergencies.
sentences.zh: 只用于紧急情况。

sentences.en: And they're kind of this group of individuals so connected.
sentences.zh: 他们是一群联系非常紧密的个体。

sentences.en: They have all these friends.
sentences.zh: 他们有很多朋友。

sentences.en: They seem so much happier, so much more self-expressive and just wise beyond their years.
sentences.zh: 他们看起来快乐得多，更善于自我表达，而且远比同龄人成熟睿智。

sentences.en: And I was reading this article and I was looking at these kids who have kind of gone against our expectations that they would be quite lonely or disconnected.
sentences.zh: 我读着这篇文章，看着这些违背了我们预期（即他们会感到孤独或与世隔绝）的孩子们，

sentences.en: And I felt very, very envious.
sentences.zh: 我感到非常、非常羡慕。

sentences.en: However, when I also started thinking like maybe I could do that, maybe I should do that, the first reaction I had was one of like panic and almost anxiety about the thought
sentences.zh: 然而，当我开始想“也许我也可以这样做，也许我应该这样做”时，我的第一反应是恐慌，甚至对“无法保持联络”以及“没有iPhone我可能无法处理各种情况”的想法感到焦虑。

sentences.en: of not being connected and all these situations I might not be able to handle without my iPhone.
sentences.zh: 这让我感到极度不安。

sentences.en: And it just brought me this extreme unease.
sentences.zh: 这让我想到，任何一旦缺失就会引发如此强烈反应的物品，

sentences.en: And it made me think any item whose absence creates that much of a reaction
sentences.zh: 都需要重新审视。

sentences.en: needs to be rethought.
sentences.zh: 因为一个无生命的物体怎么能如此严重地控制我的情绪、自我认知和能力感呢？

sentences.en: Because how can an inanimate object control my emotions, my self-perception, my sense of capability that much?
sentences.zh: 我们是怎么让事情发展到这一步的？以至于很多人如果没有手机，甚至不知道该如何在自己的城市里导航？

sentences.en: How did we kind of let it go this far to the point where a lot of people wouldn't know how to navigate their own city with their phone?
sentences.zh: 他们不知道怎么回家。

sentences.en: They wouldn't know how to get home.
sentences.zh: 他们不知道如何娱乐自己。

sentences.en: They wouldn't know how to entertain themselves.
sentences.zh: 他们不知道如何与人建立联系。

sentences.en: They wouldn't know how to be connected.
sentences.zh: 当你真正开始审视这种技术实际上是如何伤害我们时，这确实有点可怕。

sentences.en: It's kind of scary when you really start to interrogate how this technology is actually harming us.
sentences.zh: 我知道我听起来像个老太婆，像个忧心忡忡的家长，但这确实是我今天想谈的话题。

sentences.en: And I know I sound like such an old lady, like I sound like such a concerned parent, but it is what I want to talk about today.
sentences.zh: 我正处于一种奇怪的心理状态，想要重新思考我的技术使用习惯。

sentences.en: I'm in this weird mental headspace of wanting to rethink my technological habits.
sentences.zh: 我想看看你们是否也有同样的感受，以及我们如何能在这里找到某种解决方案，因为这可能不意味着要和智能手机彻底分手，

sentences.en: And I want to see if you guys are feeling the same way and also how we can find kind of a solution here because it might not be a full breakup with our smartphones,
sentences.zh: 但我们绝对需要重新思考其中的一部分。

sentences.en: but there definitely is part of this that we need to rethink.
sentences.zh: 有没有中间地带，还是我们已经走得太远了？

sentences.en: Is there a middle ground or have we just gone too far?
sentences.zh: 在智能手机出现之前，我们的大脑是什么样的？

sentences.en: What would our brains, what did our brains look like before our smartphones?
sentences.zh: 现在它们是什么样的？

sentences.en: What do they look like now?
sentences.zh: 之后它们又会是什么样的？

sentences.en: What could they look like afterwards?
sentences.zh: 还有很多其他关于这东西对我大脑影响的问题，我一直在思考。

sentences.en: And just so many other questions that I've been having around what this is doing to my mind.
sentences.zh: 所以我很高兴今天能和你们一起探讨。

sentences.en: So I'm so excited to be able to explore with you guys today.
sentences.zh: 希望能给自己一些答案，也给你们一些答案。

sentences.en: Hopefully give myself some answers, give you guys some answers.
sentences.zh: 如果你也有这种感觉，那么废话少说，让我们谈谈为什么我们或许应该和手机“分手”。

sentences.en: If you're feeling this too, without further ado, let's talk about why we should maybe be breaking up with our phones.
sentences.zh: 请继续收听。

sentences.en: Stay with us.
sentences.zh: 除了梭罗的那句话和那篇文章，最近还有其他一些让我“觉醒”的时刻。

sentences.en: So other than that Thoreau quote and that article, there have been a few other kind of wake up calls for me recently, I would say.
sentences.zh: 首先，是我和男朋友的一次谈话，他随口评论说我总是盯着手机看。

sentences.en: Firstly, it was a conversation I had with my boyfriend where he kind of made like an offhand comment about me always being on my phone.
sentences.zh: 这让我有点被冒犯了。

sentences.en: And it offended me a little bit.
sentences.zh: 但事后他对我说了句，你肯定很了解自己吧。

sentences.en: But he said to me afterwards, like, surely you know this about yourself.
sentences.zh: 你肯定知道自己是一个总是忙于工作、总是盯着手机看的人。

sentences.en: Surely you know that you're someone who's like always working, always on their phone.
sentences.zh: 这就像是你性格的一部分。

sentences.en: Like this is just kind of who you are.
sentences.zh: 我当时很吃惊，因为我从没那样看待过自己。

sentences.en: And I was taken aback because I did not think that about myself.
sentences.zh: 这对我来说是一个重大的心理盲点。

sentences.en: It was like a major psychological blind spot for me.
sentences.zh: 别人显而易见的事情，我却完全没意识到。

sentences.en: Something that is obvious to others, obviously not to me.
sentences.zh: 我想我可能在某种程度上选择了忽略别人眼中的我，以及我自己的行为方式。

sentences.en: And I kind of had chosen, I guess, in some way to ignore that this is how other people perceived me and this is how I behaved.
sentences.zh: 在那之后，我开始深入查看我的屏幕使用时间数据，然后意识到：哇，这东西控制我比我控制它要多得多。

sentences.en: Then after that, I started really going into my screen time data and just realized like, wow, I, this thing is controlling me more than I'm controlling it.
sentences.zh: 我每天拿起手机300次，每次都要看两分钟甚至更久。

sentences.en: Like I'm picking up my phone
sentences.zh: 我基本上是以1%的增量，把我的生命交给了这个无生命的东西。

sentences.en: 300 times a day, each time I'm on it for like two minutes or more.
sentences.zh: 社交媒体，我想和大多数人一样，是我花时间最多的地方。

sentences.en: I'm basically giving up my life to this inanimate thing in like 1% increments.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我可以在很大程度上为自己开脱，因为社交媒体是我的工作的一部分。

sentences.en: Social media, I think like most of us is probably where I spend most of my time.
sentences.zh: 所以这是合理的，但实际上我觉得我每天只需花30分钟或更少的时间在社交媒体上，依然能完成我的工作。

sentences.en: And I think I could largely excuse that because social media is part of my job.
sentences.zh: 这又是一个我给自己找的借口。

sentences.en: And so it was justifiable, but really I think I could only be on social media for 30 minutes a day or less and still do my job.
sentences.zh: 我想这是一个借口，为了让我不再感到尴尬、羞愧或惊慌，或者说为了阻止我意识到有些事情确实需要改变。

sentences.en: This was again, like just an excuse that I was giving to myself.
sentences.zh: 我还意识到，如果有人问我，有人拿枪指着我的头说，告诉我你最后在Instagram上看到的五件事，或者你在TikTok上刷到的最后五个视频，

sentences.en: I guess an excuse to stop me feeling a bit embarrassed or ashamed or alarmed or like to stop me from recognizing that something kind of needed to be done.
sentences.zh: 我根本说不出来。

sentences.en: There's also this realization I had that if someone asked me, someone held a gun to my head and said, tell me the last five things that you saw on Instagram or the last five reels
sentences.zh: 我所做的以及现在仍在做的很多刷手机行为，

sentences.en: that you scroll past on TikTok,
sentences.zh: 完全是无意识的。

sentences.en: I would not be able to tell them.
sentences.zh: 如果我没有专注于外面的世界（因为我在看手机），而我显然也没有专注于手机上正在发生的事情，

sentences.en: A lot of this scrolling that I was doing and that I still am doing
sentences.zh: 那么那段时间基本上是完全空白的。

sentences.en: is entirely mindless.
sentences.zh: 我基本上，

sentences.en: And if I wasn't present with the outside world, which I wasn't because I was on my phone and I obviously wasn't present with whatever was going on with my phone,
sentences.zh: 我可以争辩说，从某种奇怪的角度来看，我甚至都不是清醒的。

sentences.en: like that time is basically entirely empty.
sentences.zh: 那是一种可怕的感觉。

sentences.en: I basically,
sentences.zh: 那段时间就这样被抹去了，因为我只是，我想，因为看视频或在手机上做些琐事而变得麻木了。

sentences.en: I could see the argument that I wasn't even conscious in a weird way.
sentences.zh: 我真的想请你也问自己同样的问题。

sentences.en: And that was kind of a scary feeling.
sentences.zh: 你能做到吗？

sentences.en: That's just time that it's just been rubbed out by me just, I guess, going numb from watching reels or doing things on my phone.
sentences.zh: 你能告诉我你在TikTok上点赞的最后五个视频，或者你在Instagram上看到的最后五件真正改变了你生活的事情吗？

sentences.en: I really would ask you to ask yourself that same question.
sentences.zh: 你能告诉我你的手机或社交媒体为你提供了什么价值吗？

sentences.en: Could you do that?
sentences.zh: 是的，有一些小事，但我不认为那些价值能超过

sentences.en: Could you tell me the last five videos you've liked on TikTok or the last five things you saw on Instagram that genuinely actually changed your life?
sentences.zh: 不看手机时的那种感觉。

sentences.en: Could you give me any kind of recount on the value being provided by your phone or by social media?
sentences.zh: 我认为我们为技术找了各种借口，比如“不，你知道，我可以在网上交朋友，它让生活变得更方便，它帮我处理这个，帮我处理那个”。

sentences.en: Yes, there are small things, but I don't think that value outweighs
sentences.zh: 但别自欺欺人了。

sentences.en: what it would feel like to not be on your phone.
sentences.zh: 现实世界、户外活动，或者与朋友进行深度交流，其价值远高于

sentences.en: I think that we make all these excuses for technology that, no, you know, like I can make online friends and it's made life so much more convenient and it helps me with this
sentences.zh: 我们通过屏幕建立的任何那种人工连接。

sentences.en: and it helps me with that.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们与手机之间的紧张关系在于，它们确实是非常有用的工具，当然，它们的设计初衷就是为了具备所有这些功能

sentences.en: But let's not kid ourselves.
sentences.zh: 并考虑到便利性。

sentences.en: There's so much more value in the real world and being outdoors or being really intensely present with a friend than there is ever going to be
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们不必随身携带地图、笔记本、钱包、计算器、手电筒、通讯录和相机。

sentences.en: from some kind of artificial connection that we have through a screen.
sentences.zh: 我们不必携带所有这些东西，这真是太神奇了。

sentences.en: I think the tension that we have with our phones is that they are actually very useful tools and they have, of course, been designed to have all these capabilities
sentences.zh: 这绝对让我们的手臂和肩膀免于背负沉重的背包和手提袋。

sentences.en: and to have convenience in mind.
